description: Defines the IFirmwareUpdate interface for firmware update operations, including states, sub-states, notifications, and methods for updating firmware, getting update status, and setting auto-reboot.

classes.name: IFirmwareUpdate
classes.description: Interface for firmware update operations, including state management, notifications, and control methods.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for firmware update events.

methods.name: UpdateFirmware
methods.description: Initiates a firmware update with specified file path and type.

methods.name: GetUpdateState
methods.description: Retrieves the current firmware update status and substatus.

methods.name: SetAutoReboot
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-reboot after firmware update.
